name: Warlord (Marshal Archetype)
body:
Some marshals devote themselves to the art of combat and inspiring their allies on the front-line at a deeper level than other marshals.

Front-line Commando (Ex)

A warlord leads while being close to their allies and supporting them shoulder to shoulder. At 1st level, a warlord and allies within 30 feet gain a +2 bonus to initiative checks and a +2 bonus on attack rolls in the first round of combat.

Additionally, a warlord gains a bonus combat feat of their choice for which they meet the prerequisites.

This ability replaces auras.

Warlord’s Tactics (Ex)

At 1st level, whenever a warlord deals weapon damage to a flanked or flat-footed target, they grant an opening for their allies to maneuver into a better position. The warlord and up to one ally threatening the target can move 5 feet as an immediate action. At 11th level, a warlord and their ally may move up to 1/2 their base movement speed without provoking attacks of opportunity from the damaged creature.

This movement can be taken even if the warlord or their ally has already moved this round and does not count against their movement in the following round.

This ability can only trigger once per round.

This ability replaces aura bonus.

Invigorating Word (Ex)

At 2nd level, whenever a warlord uses inspire action they grant temporary hit points to the target equal to their class level plus their Charisma modifier. These temporary hit points last for a number of rounds equal to their Charisma modifier.

At 11th level, this ability also grants DR/– equal to the warlord’s Charisma modifier for one minute.

This ability replaces vital inspiration and triple aura.

Devoted Tactician (Ex)

At 4th level, a warlord gains two additional uses of tactician each day and activating tactician is a move action rather than a standard action.

This ability modifies tactician.

Guardian’s Strike (Ex)

At 4th level, the presence of a warlord is a threat that demands an answer. As long as a warlord threatens or has damaged a creature, until the beginning of the warlord’s next turn, allies other than the warlord gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against that creature’s attacks. At 12th level and again at 20th level, this AC bonus increases by +2.

This ability replaces twin aura.

Into the Breach (Ex)

At 8th level, a warlord has proven themself capable of turning the tides of battle and has a confidence that fuels their triumphs.

Whenever a warlord uses inspire action to grant a charge attack, they may also make a charge attack as part of that ability with all the same conditions as the targeted ally.

Crack the Shell (Ex)

At 9th level, a warlord learns to throw enemies defenses open wide with well placed strikes. As a standard action, a warlord can make a single weapon attack at their highest base attack bonus. If this attack deals damage, the warlord can choose to reduce the damage dealt by an amount up to 1/4 their class level. If they do, the next time an ally makes a weapon attack the target they add the reduction as a circumstance bonus to the attack and damage rolls against it. At 13th level, a warlord can choose to reduce the damage by up to 1/2 their class level. At 17th level, if this attack is a critical hit, the next ally to make a successful weapon attack against the target automatically confirms a critical hit.

This ability replaces tactical adjustment.

Unflinching Warlord (Ex)

At 14th level, a warlord is a symbol that maintains control of the battlefield and cannot simply allow themselves to fall. A warlord gains immunity to ability drain and energy drain. At 16th level, they gain immunity to death effects and at 19th level, they gain immunity to critical hits and precision damage.

This ability replaces expanded aura ability and quadruple aura.
